programs.description: Malaikottai Vaaliban, an ageing warrior, returns to his village only to discover it has been overrun by colonisers. He challenges them to a fight, vowing to restore freedom.
Kunjunni, an orphan, and Radha, who makes a living by selling statues of deities, love each other. However, problems arise when her father opposes their relationship.
The lives of four friends Romario, Riyas, Yoodas and Athmaram, take a dramatic turn when a girl joins their mechanical engineering class.
Dr. Ruben Isaac takes up a position in a psychiatric hospital and uses humanitarian methods to treat his patients. However, things take a turn when his real identity is uncovered.
Baiju, a government worker, lives in Kumbalam, a rusty little village on the outskirts of Kochi and is beloved by the locals. He spends his free time coaching local boys in cricket.
Newly-weds Sreeja and Prasad struggle to cope with their lives and decide to sell Sreeja's gold chain for money. However, a thief steals the chain during a bus journey, adding to their woes.
Ajayan comes back to his village to be with his ailing mother. However, things get strange when a boy comes to his house claiming to be his son.
Vincent Kombana, a parish priest, is highly respected by the people of his village. However, things take an unusual turn after he witnesses a murder.
Porinju and Mariam, two lovers who share a complicated past, and Jose, their mutual friend, become involved in a life-changing village feud.
While SI Sebastian is known for his brilliant stature, his claims are put to the test after he misplaces a body. Trouble and chaos ensue when a woman alleges the dead man to be her husband.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
Vimala and her three sisters run a theatre called Maharaja Talkies. They get in trouble when Pappachan, a rich man, forces Vimala to shut down the theatre.
When their flight is delayed, two cricketers, their friend and a photographer embark on a road trip to compete in the selection trials for a tournament. However, they face many challenges en route.
During the Mamangam fair, a new legend is born when a 12-year-old boy, Chandroth Valiya Panikkar, survives a battle with the mighty army of Zamorin.
Teresa, Rehna and Premila leave their spouses due to marital discord and live independently. Gopakumar, who eventually comes across these women, decides to reunite the split couples.
The disastrous floods in Kerala in 2018 bring about fatal implications for every individual. Later, people from different backgrounds cooperate to weather the disaster.
Joji, an engineering dropout, dreams of becoming rich without his family's help. However, things take a turn after an unexpected event in the family.
When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

Prakashan, after drinking, encounters Vinod and a young woman near a carpenter's abode. Subsequently, both men, Prakashan and Venu, perceive this duo as an affectionate couple, suspecting the woman is Nirmala.

Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.
Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.
A fierce college rivalry turns deadly when one group embrace Satanism, unleashing terror by killing their rivals one by one.
Three men compete against each other to win the affections of a beautiful woman. However, complications arise when her mother suffers from a heart attack.
Aswathy, who belongs to a royal family with dark secrets, falls in love with Vinod. However, strange events begin occurring after Aswathy mysteriously dies during childbirth.
A group of college friends meet after many years for a class reunion. However, due to some unexpected turn of events, several dark secrets are revealed, which changes their lives.
To honour his mother's final wish, Ananthan attempts to light a lamp at the family temple. However, his quest is thwarted by an evil magician who seeks to harness the temple's hidden powers.
A young man eagerly awaits his wedding, but fate twists cruelly, forcing him into a lifelong bond with a woman who harbours nothing but resentment for him.
In the 1960s, when interreligious marriages were still taboo, Moideen and Kanchanamala fell in love. Even after being forced to part ways, the two lovers fight for their undying love.

A pair of siblings, both police officers, embark on a mission to fight against some criminals after one of them incurs their wrath.
When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess, but he is not what he claims to be.
After leaving his life of crime behind, Aadhi is drawn back into the drug trade by his former gang leader. However, after meeting Seema and falling in love, he decides to atone for his past mistakes.
Ravishankar pretends to own the farmhouse of his friend Dennis when his relatives pay a visit along with their granddaughters. Chaos ensues after his prospective bride confesses her love for Dennis.
After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.
Kanan falls in love with Raddhu, the daughter of a ruthless city gangster responsible for numerous deaths. To marry her, Kanan must confront the dangers and challenges that lie ahead.
James, a highly efficient police officer, sets out to unveil the mystery behind a burglary that shook everyone in the city. He meets several people to solve the crime and put the thieves behind bars.

When a modest family with hidden martial arts skills crosses paths with a ruthless gang, they must unite to survive. Together, they fight against overwhelming odds in a thrilling and emotional battle.
Sulaiman raises his voice against the rampant corruption in his coastal village and soon becomes an influential person. However, his estranged nephew is tasked with bringing about his downfall.

A rich man is a coquette who lures women into his trap for his selfish desires. One of his employees gets compelled to fight him when he sees his employer trying the same trick to woo his girlfriend.
Upon falling in love, Tomy and Amalu, two dogs, expect babies together against the wishes of their families. However, when they decide to run away, Amalu gets kidnapped, creating more problems.
Gopan falls in love with his neighbour, Sheetal. After learning that Sheetal has a plan to reunite a separated couple, he also pools in ideas, which leads to many unexpected events.
A youth's quest for his birth mother takes an unexpected turn when his late father's widow, Aisha, enters his life, altering his path.
A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.
Balan, a barber, struggles to give his family a better living. However, his life changes when his old friend, who is a film star, comes to his village for a film shoot.
Following a tycoon's discovery of a rare oil reserve, a compassionate beggar gets trapped in the dangerous mechanisms of his rapacious scheme.
The survivor of a heart transplant attends the wedding of his donor's daughter. However, when circumstances delay his return from the venue, he gradually becomes affectionate towards her.
ACP Antony Moses has managed to track down his friend's killer when he meets with an accident resulting in partial memory loss. Soon, he is reassigned to investigate the murder and find the culprit.

Nandagopal discovers that his late father owned a bungalow in Tamil Nadu and tries to sell the property due to financial issues. However, Nachiappa, who is already staying there, refuses to vacate it.
Friends John, Kichu, Roopesh, Bava and Babumon decide to have a party on New Year's Eve. However, a series of events leads to a lot of unpleasantness and a rift between John and Kichu.
Abraham and Lincoln are drawn into a turbulent world of crime and loyalty, where personal choices and past ties shape their unpredictable path.
Roy, Amir, Soorya and Gauri are four cancer patients seeking treatment at the same hospital. They become friends and decide to help each other fulfil their dreams.
After the COVID-19 pandemic hits Sri Lanka, a family travels to India to begin a new life. Their arrival quickly transforms their new neighbourhood.
Thomas Kutty buys a haunted bungalow and convinces his friends to stay with him on the first night. The trouble begins when they actually see the ghost of the mistress who was killed 70 years ago.
Vasoottan, an autorickshaw driver, helps Parvathy and her distressed family to deliver a hundred Jamnapari goats so that she can save her farm from the evil clutches of Sridharan.
Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.
The life of a struggling actor changes when two individuals take advantage of him and try to dupe him. However, he strives to overcome his obstacles.

Raghu, a responsible youth, faces the wrath of the villagers as he is the son of a lazy postman. However, Raghu's life takes a turn when he encounters Yasin Mubarak, a notorious man.
A wealthy heiress plans to implicate her former boyfriend for her murder by hiring an assassin. Things take a turn when a thief enters the house at the same time.
Ram does not believe in everlasting love and this ideology does not go down well with Jaanu. When Abhishek, a police officer, asks him the reason, he tells him about Rooba, his former lover.

After Subramanian has to leave his aged father alone to go to Russia, he returns with a robot to take care of him. Even though hesitant at first, his father soon develops a strong bond with the robot.
After being forsaken by his mother in a temple, Aravindan, a five-year-old boy, is taken in by a hotelier. Against all odds, Aravindan clings to the hope of reuniting with his mother.
After moving into a hostel in Bangalore for their engineering course, three teenagers get into a terrible brawl with their seniors. To exact revenge, they decide to befriend a gangster.
Barroz, a loyal servant, is compelled by magic to guard Cristovao da Gama's treasure for four centuries, waiting for a true heir to claim it.
Four engineering students battle their professor's supernatural schemes to control the campus, encountering cursed gadgets and bizarre scenarios along the way.
Rajesh, a gold dealer, lends some gold jewelry for a village wedding, unaware of the betrayal ahead. However, the bride's husband plans to keep the gold and kill Rajesh.

Unni Kesavan's carefree and rebellious life is challenged when childhood friend Indira returns, bringing warmth, reflection and a chance for personal growth.
Three inseparable friends devise an ingenious ploy to fund a destitute woman's marriage. However, destiny plays a cruel game after an unscrupulous individual steal their hard-earned funds.
Vishnu, a teacher, gets transferred to a village where he loses his son in an accident. He decides to hide this news from his wife, who is in prison, till she is released.

Jaison, a teenager, has a crush on Keerthy, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. To make things worse, he gets in trouble with Ravi, the new teacher who is liked by everyone, especially Keerthy.
A young aspiring film director who seeks to make his directorial debut decides to use a real-life gangster as inspiration for his first movie.
An affluent man is called upon to hand over his vast plot of land to the government. However, situations take a turn when he brings the influential Neyyattinkara Gopan into the picture.
In the coastal village of Marlur, Ashoka's innocent crush sparks rumours of ghostly possession, creating comedic chaos and unexpected twists.
An unexpected twist in the tale of taxi driver Shanmughan's life puts his fondness for his old car to the ultimate test.
A historic rifle club in the Western Ghats becomes the centre of a fight for survival when a dangerous arms dealer and his gang come seeking revenge.
